name: catalyst_retrieval_evidence_ledger_v1
purpose: Separate external baselines, paper-only context, internal historical comparators, internal anchors, capability slices, and invalid/superseded evidence. A value may only be called a baseline delta when support and metric semantics match and the comparator identity is explicit.

classes.A_local_external_same_support: External method/author score is executed locally and Catalyst is evaluated on identical support; direct deltas allowed.
classes.B_local_external_partial_support: External method scores are locally available but support is incomplete or differs; report coverage and side-by-side values, no direct full-task delta.
classes.C_paper_only_external: Baseline values are quoted from the paper; not a local rerun. Context only unless exact metric/split comparison is explicitly labeled unpaired paper comparison.
classes.D_internal_comparator: Our own previous model/router/hybrid. Useful for iteration progress or ablation, never call it an external baseline.
classes.E_capability_slice: Same system under different visibility/few-shot/difficulty conditions. No baseline required; the contrast itself is the result.
classes.F_invalid_or_superseded: Evidence that is duplicate, exposed under current training, support-misaligned, or otherwise unsuitable for current claims.

entries.support: 513 reactions x 1391 proteins, full current-library task
entries.reason: Pure EnzymeCAGE exists on TPS-native scored support, but it does not score the complete 513x1391 task. The old RF/CAGE row is our own historical system and must not occupy an external-baseline column.

entries.task: Historical TPS strict double-cold R2E (older universe)
entries.support: 714 query-cells on older 513 reactions x 1391 proteins universe
entries.reason: Valid internal old-vs-new evidence on the older 513x1391 TPS universe. It must not be paired with current 1421x453 MARTS E2R results as a symmetric bidirectional benchmark.

entries.task: Current TPS strict bidirectional MARTS benchmark
entries.support: 1421 proteins x 453 reactions; confirmatory20260726 partition family
entries.symmetry_status: candidate universe and split family are bidirectional, but final evidence is asymmetric: E2R finalized; R2E still lacks an equivalent finalized route confirmation.
entries.reason: This is the correct current TPS strict universe for discussing bidirectional capability. Internal route comparisons are valid; they are not external-baseline deltas.
Visible-vs-not-visible is a condition contrast for the same system; it should not be described as a baseline comparison.

entries.task: TPS few-shot homolog and remote-family expansion
entries.reason: This is a simple algorithmic baseline/ablation, not an external published model baseline.

entries.support: 226 reactions with complete original candidate pools under locally executable author inputs
entries.reason: This is the cleanest locally reproduced pure EnzymeCAGE comparison. It is a separate external benchmark, not the missing TPS-513 baseline.
Paper numbers are not a local full author-equivalent rerun.

entries.claim_scope: reaction-novel stress only; positive-protein novelty is low
secondary baseline alignment only; adapted common support, not current canonical external snapshot

entries.external_baseline: EnzGFM-1.5B paper mean over five runs; retrieval head not locally reproduced
entries.claim_scope: known-reaction sequence-divergence only; all 1573 test reactions seen in train

entries.current_support: 1122 pairs, 890 proteins, 208 reactions; protein/reaction/pair all 100% unseen vs clean2023
entries.external_baseline_status: NONE_REQUIRED_FOR_ABSOLUTE_EXTERNAL_GENERALIZATION; current deltas are internal-anchor deltas, not external-model deltas

entries.role: production model advancement only; baseline/current are both Catalyst-family models

entries.task: CAGE common scored reservoir with broad-adapted neural models
entries.reason: Broad-adapted neural experts have integrated-association exposure and produce ~98-99% Hit@10; useful only as recovery diagnostics, not fair external generalization or TPS baseline evidence.
Cold labels were relative to older benchmark partitions; current clean2023 overlap is substantial. Do not use as current external generalization.
v1/v2 duplicate v3 metrics; retain v3 only.
Superseded by locally reproduced complete226 support; retain only provenance/history.

gaps_to_fill.gap: TPS 513x1391 database-completion R2E lacks a complete same-support external baseline. Pure EnzymeCAGE is locally measured but incomplete-support; internal RF/HGB+CAGE cannot substitute.
Current MARTS 1421x453 strict R2E is measured on the same universe as E2R but lacks an equivalent finalized route confirmation.
Current MARTS 1421x453 strict bidirectional benchmark has no aligned external model baseline; this is optional if claims are limited to internal route improvement rather than external superiority.

can_ignore: 98%+ common-reservoir broad-adapted neural recovery values as external evidence

tps_universe_note.rule: Never splice R2E from the legacy universe and E2R from the current MARTS universe into one symmetric table.
